tips.text: Go straight for the Coda node and Duet loop, not generic Höllvania missions.
Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the progress banks, but a Quick Correct Heartcell is lost.
Slot Immuno Shield and Instant Secure (+15% each) once you know the Antivirus.
Run Quick Correct once you are farming several weapons; each correct stab has a 10% chance of a Heartcell, squad-wide.
Do the Showdown in a group, or bring Revenant or Nyx solo; Valkyr also works.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin skips shields and deletes Gauss and other shield frames.
Restart the Showdown if a band member spawns invisible or the band will not jump down.
Stockpile Heartcells and buy when a high-percentage roll shows up; they do not expire.
Rank up before farming Heartcells in bulk; they sit unspent until Mastery Rank 17.
Expect a few hours for a first Coda including Antivirus luck, and much less after; players call it the fastest adversary system.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for extra standing.
